sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 9:66

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 9:66:1
items.html: They do not pierce all the partitions of the Guf of ZA, etc., for if so she would have been built in a single moment, etc.: That is, those lights do not come to the female in the same measure that they are in the Guf of ZA itself, where they are in the discernment of Gadlut — for that would be reckoned as piercing and nullifying the partitions of ZA, and the Guf of the Nukva and the Guf of ZA would become one Guf with no partitions to separate between them. Rather, they come to her through a restricted orifice, that is, through the screen of phase one, as it was at the time of the Katnut of ZA, when he had the discernment of an orifice at the Chazeh, in the secret of the Peh of his head, as above, in the adjacent item.
